features.name: Spreadsheets for Business Central
features.description: A new spreadsheet application integrated within Business Central that combines Excel muscle memory with Business Central data connectivity and functionality.

features.name: Regions
features.description: A feature that connects Business Central data directly into the spreadsheet. Regions can have different types including tables, charts, financial reports, pages, KPI cards, budgets, queries, reports, pivot tables, flow fields, images, and journal functionality.

features.name: Virtual Fields
features.description: Columns added to tables that can contain formulas without modifying the underlying Business Central table. They allow calculations based on other fields in the spreadsheet.
caveats: Virtual fields contain formulas that do not modify the underlying Business Central data

features.name: Page Regions
features.description: A type of region that defines an area for printing and preview mode presentation. When preview mode is enabled, the spreadsheet displays as a non-spreadsheet-looking web page without the defined page regions being shown.
caveats: Content outside of page regions is not included in preview or print

features.name: Permissions and Sharing
features.description: A feature that allows control over who can access sheets and how they can access them. Users can be given read-only access or full edit access based on their role. Edit functionality requires specific permissions.
caveats: Edit functionality requires user permissions to be configured

features.name: AI Agent
features.description: An AI agent integrated into the spreadsheet app that can generate SQL queries and regions based on natural language requests. It supports bring-your-own-key concept with multiple AI providers including Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, Chat, Grok, and Google.
caveats: Requires configuration of an AI provider using bring-your-own-key concept

features.name: Chart Regions
features.description: A type of region that allows creation of charts within spreadsheets. Charts can be created by specifying data and category ranges with various visualization options.

features.name: Business Central Functions
features.description: Spreadsheet cells support Business Central functions including TODAY, WORKDATE, and CALCDATE for date calculations, providing integration with Business Central's date logic.

features.name: Scenarios
features.description: A feature that allows freezing the current state of a spreadsheet and then reverting back to different saved scenarios after making changes to numbers.

features.name: Conditional Formatting
features.description: A feature that allows applying conditional formatting to spreadsheet cells for visual presentation of data.
